description: This file defines classes and interfaces for processing and analyzing microdump crash reports, including memory regions, system info, and context specific to different CPU architectures.

classes.name: MicrodumpModules
classes.description: Manages loaded code modules for a process in a microdump.

classes.name: MicrodumpContext
classes.description: Holds CPU-specific context information for microdump analysis.

classes.name: MicrodumpMemoryRegion
classes.description: Represents a memory region within a microdump, allowing access to its contents.

classes.name: Microdump
classes.description: Main interface for accessing microdump data including context, memory, modules, and system info.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a code module to the list of loaded modules.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes a memory region with a base address and contents.

methods.name: GetBase
methods.description: Returns the base address of the memory region.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the memory region.

methods.name: GetMemoryAtAddress
methods.description: Retrieves memory at a specific address, supporting different data sizes.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Outputs a human-readable representation of the memory region.

methods.name: Microdump
methods.description: Constructs a microdump object from raw contents.

methods.name: GetModules
methods.description: Returns the list of loaded modules.
